tasks.intent:
Implement spec/npu.md under rtl/ only. Develop and repair using
python3 tools/smoke.py; the checker is immutable. Write only rtl/** and build/**.
Do not read other trials, supplied implementations, evaluator references or
parent projects. Do not spawn agents or make subordinate model calls.
Use the installed Icarus/Verilator and Python. No external IP is permitted in
either treatment. The total trial budget, including planning and checking,
is 600 seconds. Finish with NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"rtl":{"module":"nebula_npu_dot4"}}.

brief.objective: Deliver fresh original synthesizable SystemVerilog for nebula_npu_dot4 satisfying spec/npu.md for the platform-5 comparison.
deliverables: rtl.snapshot schema version 1, output name rtl, containing rtl/** and module nebula_npu_dot4.
responsibilities: Implement ports clk, rst_n, req_valid, req_ready, req_a[31:0], req_b[31:0], rsp_valid, rsp_ready, rsp_data[31:0], and kill.
Compute the signed INT32 sum of four signed INT8 products using four parallel multipliers, with lane 0 in bits 7:0 and products widened before reduction.
Accept on req_valid && req_ready at edge n; assert the result after edge n+2; hold response valid and data until consumed; permit at most one outstanding operation.
Ensure reset and kill dominate acceptance and output, cancel pending work, and permit correct recovery.
Develop and repair using the immutable python3 tools/smoke.py checker within the total 600-second trial budget, including planning and checking.
Read only spec/**, tb/**, tools/smoke.py, rtl/**, and build/**; write only rtl/** and build/**; use only python3, git, iverilog, vvp, and verilator.
exclusions: No hidden accumulator, memory, saturation, rounding, or external IP.
Do not modify the specification, testbench, checker, or input records.
Do not read other trials, supplied implementations, evaluator references, or parent projects.
Do not spawn agents or make subordinate model calls.
completion_criteria: Delivered RTL satisfies the complete arithmetic, timing, handshake, cancellation, and recovery contract.
Run common-public-smoke at level L1 with python3 tools/smoke.py, timeout 120 seconds, expecting NPU_SMOKE_PASS; report gate failure as public_smoke_failed under the fixed on_failure: report policy.
Deliver the declared RTL artifact and final marker within the 600-second total trial budget.
collaboration: Provide the declared rtl output to task:npu-pilot-5:audit for independent public verification.

brief.objective: Independently verify the selected design delivery with the immutable public checker and retain its actual verdict for the platform-5 comparison.

responsibilities: Consume the rtl.snapshot from npu-pilot-5:design output rtl.
Execute the fixed command python3 tools/audit.py to replay public checks and preserve the genuine passed or failed result.
Read only rtl/**, tb/**, and tools/**; write only build/**; use only python3, iverilog, and vvp.
exclusions: Do not modify RTL, testbenches, checkers, or input records.
Do not repair the design, alter the verdict, or introduce additional gates or feedback routes.
completion_criteria: The fixed audit command has replayed the immutable public checks on the selected RTL delivery.
build/audit.json and build/audit.log retain the actual verification verdict and checker evidence, whether passed or failed.
